eval: (async () => { await import('/sandbox/party_follow.js'); PF.suite = 'party.follow.review'; const r = await PF.ready(); __game.setTime(12); PF.nobody(); window.__pf = { p0: PF.programs(), scene0: PF.scene() }; const g = __game.game; const refused = await __game.party.join('nobody-here'); PF.expect(refused === null && g.party === null && !g.engine.input.bindings.party && !PF.partyLoaded() && !('party' in __game.state()), 'a refused join makes no party (no party code, no G binding, no state key): ' + JSON.stringify([refused, !!g.party])); return JSON.stringify({ ...r, refused, party: !!g.party }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; const v = PF.npc('farmer'); v.name = /** a number read from level data */ (5); let threw = null; let r1 = null; try { r1 = await __game.party.join('Nobody Here'); } catch (e) { threw = String(e); } PF.expect(threw === null && r1 === null && g.party === null, 'a villager named by a number: looking a name up throws nothing (and makes no party): ' + threw); const r2 = await __game.party.join('5'); PF.expect(!!r2 && r2.members[0].name === '5' && typeof g.party.records[0].name === 'string', 'it joins by its name (as text): ' + JSON.stringify(r2?.members[0])); let threw2 = null; try { g.party.find('no such member'); __game.party.leave('Nobody'); } catch (e) { threw2 = String(e); } PF.expect(threw2 === null && !!g.party.find('5'), 'the party finds members by a number name and looks others up without throwing: ' + threw2); PF.expect(!!g.party._nav, 'the first join builds the party\'s walk grid ahead (in idle time): ' + !!g.party._nav); __game.party.leave('5'); v.name = 'Old Tobin'; return JSON.stringify({ joined: r2?.members.map((m) => m.name), nav: !!g.party._nav }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; PF.fakeUI(); await __game.party.join('guard'); const pl = g.player; pl.facing.set(1, 0, 0); pl.sprite.faceVector(1, 0); __game.teleport(36, 21.5); await PF.sleep(400); await PF.drive([[37.5, 21.5], [38.5, 19.5]], { label: 'the guard along' }); await PF.sleep(1200); const m = PF.member('guard'); const at = [m.position.x, m.position.z]; const npc = PF.npc('guard'); const home0 = [npc.home.x, npc.home.z]; __game.party.leave('guard'); await PF.sleep(3000); const d = Math.hypot(npc.position.x - at[0], npc.position.z - at[1]); const h = Math.hypot(npc.home.x - at[0], npc.home.z - at[1]); PF.expect(npc.present && d < 0.5 && h < 0.01, 'a post villager who leaves away from its home stays where it left (its home now) — it does not walk back home through the player: ' + JSON.stringify({ at, home0, now: [npc.position.x, npc.position.z], d, h })); return JSON.stringify({ at, home0, d: +d.toFixed(3), h }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; await __game.party.join('elder'); await __game.party.join('innkeeper'); await PF.sleep(1500); const open = __game.party.menu(true, 'innkeeper'); const panel = g.ui.party.panel; const shown0 = panel.memberId; const talkMember = __game.talkTo('elder'); const talkVillager = __game.talkTo('merchant'); PF.expect(open && !talkMember && !talkVillager && !g.ui.dialog.isOpen && !g.busy, 'the tactics panel holds the story: talkTo refuses (a member, a villager) while it is open: ' + JSON.stringify([open, talkMember, talkVillager])); __game.party.leave('elder'); await PF.frame(); PF.expect(panel.isOpen && (panel.fake || panel.memberId === 'innkeeper'), 'a member leaves while the panel is open: it stays on the member it showed: ' + JSON.stringify([shown0, panel.memberId])); const j = await __game.party.join('bard'); await PF.frame(); PF.expect(!!j && panel.isOpen && (panel.fake || panel.memberId === 'innkeeper'), 'a member joins while it is open: still on that member: ' + panel.memberId); __game.party.menu(false); await PF.frame(); const after = (await PF.talk('scholar')).ok; PF.expect(after && !g.ui.dialog.isOpen, 'closed again: talkTo talks'); return JSON.stringify({ shown0, now: panel.memberId ?? null, fake: !!panel.fake, after }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; await __game.party.join('elder'); const pl = g.player; const mat = pl.silhouetteMaterial; pl.facing.set(0, 0, -1); pl.sprite.faceVector(0, -1); __game.teleport(40, 28); await PF.sleep(1500); const clear0 = PF.coverage(); PF.expect(!g.party.coversPlayer && mat.opacity > 0.54 && mat.colorWrite, 'nobody in front of the player: its silhouette is drawn: ' + JSON.stringify({ clear0, opacity: mat.opacity })); const m = PF.member('elder'); m.direct(); m.placeAt(40, 29.1); m.sprite.faceVector(0, -1); await PF.sleep(500); const c = PF.coverage(); PF.expect(g.party.coversPlayer && c.sum > 0.2 && mat.opacity < 0.01 && !mat.colorWrite && !mat.depthWrite, 'a member in front of the player on the screen (1.1 u toward the camera): the player\'s x-ray silhouette faded out — no pale ghost over the member: ' + JSON.stringify({ cover: c, covers: g.party.coversPlayer, opacity: mat.opacity, colorWrite: mat.colorWrite })); const m2 = PF.member('innkeeper'); m2.direct(); m2.placeAt(40.3, 29.7); m.placeAt(38.6, 28.4); await PF.sleep(500); const c2 = PF.coverage(); PF.expect(c2.sum > 0.03 && g.party.coversPlayer && mat.opacity < 0.01, 'another member 1.7 u toward the camera, a little aside, covering part of the player: faded too: ' + JSON.stringify({ cover: c2, opacity: mat.opacity })); m2.placeAt(41.4, 28.4); m.placeAt(40, 29.1); await PF.sleep(400); PF.expect(PF.programs() === __pf.p0, 'no program compiled by the fade: ' + PF.programs()); return JSON.stringify({ cover: c, cover2: c2, opacity: mat.opacity }); })()
(() => { const pl = __game.game.player; pl.setSilhouetteEnabled(true); pl.fadeSilhouette = () => {}; pl._silhouetteFade = 1; pl._applySilhouetteFade(); return 'the old silhouette (no fade)'; })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; const pl = g.player; delete pl.fadeSilhouette; const mat = pl.silhouetteMaterial; await PF.sleep(300); PF.expect(mat.opacity < 0.01, 'fading again'); for (const id of ['elder', 'innkeeper']) PF.member(id).release(); const t0 = performance.now(); const back = await PF.until(() => !g.party.coversPlayer && mat.opacity > 0.54 && mat.colorWrite, 4000); PF.expect(back, 'the members back on their spots: the silhouette is drawn again: ' + JSON.stringify({ opacity: mat.opacity, cover: PF.coverage() })); return JSON.stringify({ back, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0), members: PF.brief() }); })()

(async () => { const r = PF.sweep(1); PF.expect(r.bad === 0 && r.unplaced <= r.placements * 3 * 0.01, 'three members placed behind the player on every standable spot of Emberfall (4 facings) stand on standable ground, reachable from it (on the player\'s own spot only in a pocket too small for three: < 1 %): ' + JSON.stringify(r)); return JSON.stringify(r); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; for (const m of [...g.party.members]) __game.party.leave(m.id); await PF.sleep(300); const sc = PF.scene(); PF.expect(sc.members === 0 && PF.programs() === __pf.p0, 'nobody left: no member sprite, no program compiled by anything the party did: ' + JSON.stringify([sc, PF.programs()])); return JSON.stringify({ scene: sc, programs: PF.programs(), stats: g.party.stats, failed: PF.failed }); })()
